5137581018841088.name: Autofill event
5137581018841088.idea: Listen for the autofill event on a form drawn in a 3D scene or on cloth, and run a fill animation over exactly the fields the browser filled. Also measure whether the autofill preview (the grey suggested value) is painted into the element picture.

5146265241387008.name: Clip Text overflow on user interaction
5146265241387008.idea: Text with an ellipsis switches to clip while it is edited. Check that the switch raises a paint event so a drawn field shows the full text during editing.

5123253146353664.name: CSS light-dark() with image values
5123253146353664.idea: light-dark() with images lets one drawable element carry both a light and a dark background image. Draw the same element into two canvases with different color-scheme values and compare.

5112398709129216.name: Prerendering cross-origin iframes
5112398709129216.idea: Board tiles are iframes drawn into a canvas. With the Supports-Loading-Mode header, cross-origin tiles would be prerendered with the board. Measure whether a prerendered iframe already has a picture on the first paint event.

5155080092385280.name: Decisions API
5155080092385280.idea: The Decisions API classifies text on the device with no generation step. Use it to pick which effect or layout a drawn block gets (for example, tag each streamed paragraph as code, warning or prose and draw each kind through a different shader).

6494349985841152.name: Language Detector API
6494349985841152.idea: Detect the language of each drawn block and show it as a label drawn by the canvas beside the block. Feeds the translation lens, which needs a source language.

5134603979063296.name: Prompt API
5134603979063296.idea: Stream the model's answer into a drawable element and let the canvas draw each new block with an effect. Send the canvas picture of an element back to the model as image input, so the model describes or checks the UI that the user sees after the shader has run.

6325545693478912.name: Prompt API Sampling Mode
6325545693478912.idea: Sampling presets change how varied the output is. Expose them as a control on the streaming demo.

5164677291835392.name: Proofreader API
5164677291835392.idea: Run the proofreader on a drawn text field and mark each correction with a custom highlight. The highlight is painted into the element picture (measured), so a shader can animate the marks.

5172811302961152.name: Translator API
5172811302961152.idea: A lens that shows the text under it in another language. The page keeps a second, hidden copy of the subtree, translates its text nodes on the device and draws that copy inside the lens circle, aligned with the original.

5087964794322944.name: Language Detector API on Android
5087964794322944.idea: LanguageDetector now exists on Android, so the translation lens can detect the source language on the phone.

5138651886518272.name: LanguageDetector support for Traditional vs. Simplified Chinese
5138651886518272.idea: Detection separates zh-Hant from zh-Hans, so the lens can pick the right translation pair for Chinese text.

5112320150470656.name: Rewriter API
5112320150470656.idea: A lens that rewrites the text under it in a simpler or shorter register. Same pipeline as the translation lens.

4712595362414592.name: Writer API
4712595362414592.idea: Use the Writer API as a second source of streamed HTML for the materialise demo.

5193953788559360.name: Summarizer API
5193953788559360.idea: Semantic zoom for the board: when a tile is drawn smaller than its text can be read, replace the tile's picture with a summary produced on the device and drawn at a readable size. Zooming in swaps the full document back.

6309243756085248.name: Summarizer API performance preference
6309243756085248.idea: The performance preference picks a smaller model. Use it for the zoomed-out summaries, where latency matters more than quality.

5328467685801984.name: CSS env variable for OS-level font scale
5328467685801984.idea: env(preferred-text-scale) gives the OS text scale. A canvas that draws DOM gets the larger text for free; a page that sizes its canvas buffer by hand has to follow it. Add a check to the accessibility audit.

5745430754230272.name: ARIA Notify API
5745430754230272.idea: When a shader changes what an element looks like without changing the DOM (a burn transition, a page flip), call ariaNotify() to tell a screen reader what happened.

5112244702674944.name: meta name="text-scale"
5112244702674944.idea: With the text-scale meta tag the root font size follows the OS setting. Audit each demo at 200% text scale: element pictures grow, so canvas buffers and hit boxes must be measured again.

5161589307867136.name: aria-actions
5161589307867136.idea: aria-actions exposes secondary actions of a composite widget. Check that the actions of a widget drawn in a canvas are still listed.

5117755740913664.name: WebMCP
5117755740913664.idea: Register WebMCP tools for a UI that is drawn in a canvas (a 3D form, a board of tiles). The agent calls the tools; the canvas draws what the agent is doing over the live DOM: the element it targets, the value it types, a marker that moves between fields.

5083257285378048.name: Animation.overallProgress
5083257285378048.idea: Animation.overallProgress is a 0 to 1 number for a whole animation. Read it each frame as the progress uniform of a shader transition.

5152759609425920.name: trigger-scope
5152759609425920.idea: trigger-scope limits animation trigger names to a subtree, so several canvas-slot components on one page can each use the same trigger name for their own effect.

6522328437620736.name: Timeline Named Range "scroll"
6522328437620736.idea: The scroll named range of a view timeline covers the full scroll distance. Use it to drive a uniform across the whole page while the element stays in a pinned canvas.

6046278267043840.name: Animation accessor on animation and transition events
6046278267043840.idea: animationstart and transitionrun events carry their Animation object. The fx library can use it to find the running animation for an element and read its progress.

5071640598806528.name: No Auto-Rewind for AnimationTrigger Play Methods
5071640598806528.idea: Trigger play methods no longer rewind a finished animation. A scroll-triggered shader reveal therefore plays once.

5183481574850560.name: Web Install API
5183481574850560.idea: navigator.install() installs an app from a manifest URL. An installed demo app is where the window features (drag regions, window controls) can be tried.

5152834368700416.name: HTML install element
5152834368700416.idea: The install element is a browser-owned control. Measure whether it is drawn as a canvas child and whether it accepts a click there. Capability elements report "occluded or distorted" in the same position (measured).

5098834847072256.name: Audio Output Devices API: setPreferredSinkId()
5098834847072256.idea: setPreferredSinkId() routes all audio of the page to one device. Add an output picker to the audio page.

5138797158334464.name: Web Bluetooth: Make BluetoothRemoteGATTServer an EventTarget
5138797158334464.idea: GATT server events with addEventListener() make reconnect handling for a Bluetooth display simpler.

5177569273053184.name: Web Bluetooth: BluetoothRemoteGATTServer.maxWriteWithoutResponseSize
5177569273053184.idea: maxWriteWithoutResponseSize gives the largest packet for one write. Use it to chunk frame data sent to a Bluetooth LED matrix or e-paper display.

5242724333387776.name: CSS Container Queries flat tree lookup
5242724333387776.idea: Container queries look up containers in the flat tree, so a slotted child of canvas-slot can query the size of the canvas host that draws it.

5195333643272192.name: allow more pseudo-elements and pseudo-classes after ::part()
5195333643272192.idea: More pseudo-elements and pseudo-classes are allowed after ::part(). A page can style parts of a component that draws itself in a canvas, including states.

5083057057693696.name: @property support <string> syntax
5083057057693696.idea: Register a custom property with the string syntax and use it to name the effect: --fx-name: "ripple". The effect then takes part in the cascade and in style queries.

5094192052436992.name: CSS Anchor Positioning: anchor-scope
5094192052436992.idea: anchor-scope limits anchor names to a subtree. Each repeated card in a canvas can use the same anchor name for its own tooltip.

4755025804132352.name: Support currentcolor in Relative Color Syntax
4755025804132352.idea: Relative colours from currentcolor let an effect derive its tint from the element's text colour in CSS and pass it to the shader as a registered colour property.

5203950077476864.name: CSS Anchor Positioning: allow anchor-size() in inset and margin Properties
5203950077476864.idea: anchor-size() in inset and margin lets a tooltip offset scale with the drawn size of its anchor.

5072263730167808.name: CSS Scroll State Container Queries
5072263730167808.idea: Scroll-state queries restyle a drawn element when it is stuck, snapped or scrollable, and the change raises a paint event with no script (measured). A sticky header can set a custom property when stuck and the canvas draws it through a blur shader from that moment.

4680129030651904.name: CSS advanced attr() function
4680129030651904.idea: Typed attr() reads an attribute as a number, colour or length in any property. Write the uniforms as attributes: fx-amount="0.4" and --fx-amount: attr(fx-amount type(<number>)). No script copies values.

5090853643354112.name: CSS Highlight Inheritance
5090853643354112.idea: Highlight pseudo-elements inherit through the highlight chain. Set ::selection once on a canvas-slot host and every drawn child uses it. Selection and custom highlights are painted into the picture (measured).

5093129273999360.name: ::scroll-button() pseudo elements
5093129273999360.idea: ::scroll-button() pseudo-elements of a scroller inside a canvas are drawn into the picture (measured). They can be drawn anywhere, for example at the ends of a 3D cylinder of slides, and still scroll the real list.

5107436833472512.name: CSS Inertness
5107436833472512.idea: interactivity: inert stops hit testing on a drawn element while it is still painted (measured). Use it for the copy of an element that is shown but must not take input, such as a portal's second copy or a state that is mid-transition.

5172258539307008.name: CSS shape() function
5172258539307008.idea: shape() in clip-path is applied to the element picture (measured). Responsive shapes come out of CSS, and the shader receives the shape as the alpha channel.

5192332683771904.name: ::column pseudo element for Carousel
5192332683771904.idea: ::column fragments of a multicol scroller get scroll markers. Draw each column as one page of a book with a page-turn shader, with the markers as the page numbers.

5160035463462912.name: ::scroll-marker and ::scroll-marker-group for Carousel
5160035463462912.idea: ::scroll-marker pseudo-elements are drawn into the picture and a real click on a drawn marker scrolls the list (measured). A CSS-only carousel can be drawn as a cover flow or a film strip with its native markers still working.

4728308937523200.name: CSS Logical Overflow
4728308937523200.idea: overflow-inline and overflow-block set scrolling relative to the writing mode. Use them in the carousel so it follows vertical writing modes.

5146250411769856.name: CSS dynamic-range-limit property
5146250411769856.idea: dynamic-range-limit caps how bright HDR content may be, per element. A float16 canvas keeps element colours above 1.0 (measured: 1.82 read back). Use the property to keep body text at standard brightness while one button is drawn brighter than white.

5191129693421568.name: Rename `string` attr() type to `raw-string`
5191129693421568.idea: The attr() string type was renamed raw-string. The fx library has to use the new name.

6313805904347136.name: CSS if() function
6313805904347136.idea: if() picks a value from media, supports and style conditions in one declaration. Use it to select an effect or a uniform by state: --fx-amount: if(style(--pressed: 1): 1; else: 0).

5165902775189504.name: Support offset-path: shape()
5165902775189504.idea: offset-path: shape() moves an element along a responsive path. Animate a drawable element along the outline of another element's border-shape.

6225478530367488.name: CSS sibling-index() and sibling-count()
6225478530367488.idea: sibling-index() and sibling-count() give each element its position as a number. Use them for staggered uniforms with no script: --fx-delay: calc(sibling-index() * 60ms), or to place the nth card on a ring.

5091423843778560.name: CSS Sign-Related Functions: abs(), sign()
5091423843778560.idea: abs() and sign() let CSS compute mirrored or folded uniforms, such as distance from the centre item.

5112558941634560.name: Interpolation progress functional notation: CSS progress() function
5112558941634560.idea: progress() returns where a value sits between two others as a number. Map a container width or a scroll position straight into a 0 to 1 uniform.

5357329815699456.name: Corner shaping (corner-shape, superellipse, squircle)
5357329815699456.idea: corner-shape is applied to the element picture (measured with bevel). Squircles, notches and scoops arrive in the texture as alpha, so a lighting shader can treat the corner profile as a bevel and shade it.

5179721933651968.name: CSS Custom Functions
5179721933651968.idea: Custom functions return values from parameters. Publish effect presets as functions: --fx-amount: --ease-out-back(var(--t)).

5082469066604544.name: CSS caret-animation property
5082469066604544.idea: caret-animation: manual stops the blink, and the caret is painted into the picture (measured). A shader can then draw its own caret motion from the caret's position in consecutive frames: a smear between positions, a glow, a fade.

5189126177161216.name: CSS scroll-target-group property
5189126177161216.idea: scroll-target-group turns a list of links into scroll markers. A table of contents drawn in a canvas tracks the section in view with :target-current and no script.

4740780497043456.name: CSS typed arithmetic
4740780497043456.idea: Typed arithmetic divides lengths by lengths. Convert a size in em or cqw into a unitless uniform inside calc().

5162799714795520.name: Nested view transitions groups
5162799714795520.idea: Nested view transition groups keep clipping and 3D context between groups. The view transitions page can test whether a nested group that contains a drawable canvas keeps its picture.

4552801607483392.name: highlightsFromPoint API
4552801607483392.idea: highlightsFromPoint() returns the custom highlights under a point. On an element drawn away from its layout box it returns the highlight at the drawn position in Chromium 157 and nothing in 153 (measured). Use it to make highlighted words clickable on a warped surface.

5070655645155328.name: Custom property enumeration in getComputedStyle()
5070655645155328.idea: getComputedStyle() now enumerates custom properties. The fx library can find every --fx-* property set on an element and bind each to a uniform of the same name, with no list in script.

5070829070188544.name: The `::interest-button` pseudo element
5070829070188544.idea: The ::interest-button pseudo-element gives touch users a button that opens the hint. Measure whether it is drawn with its element.

5120827674722304.name: :target-before and :target-after pseudo-classes
5120827674722304.idea: :target-before and :target-after match markers before and after the current one. Style passed and upcoming slides differently and let the shader read that state as a custom property.

5184992749289472.name: Range syntax for style container queries and if()
5184992749289472.idea: Range syntax in style queries: @container style(--fx-progress > 0.5). CSS can change an element's content half way through a shader transition.

5177580990496768.name: CSS Anchored Fallback Container Queries
5177580990496768.idea: anchored(fallback) queries tell a popover which fallback position it got. A tooltip anchored to an element on a rotating 3D panel can flip its arrow when the panel turns.

5195073796177920.name: CSS find-in-page highlight pseudos
5195073796177920.idea: Find-in-page results are now a highlight pseudo-element. Style ::search-text with a strong colour and check, with the find bar open, whether the match is painted into the element picture and whether a shader can make the current match pulse.

5194034339512320.name: Non-Tree-Scoped container-name Matching
5194034339512320.idea: Container names match across shadow boundaries. A slotted child can query a named container declared inside the component that draws it.

5083137520173056.name: @scroll-state scrolled support
5083137520173056.idea: scroll-state(scrolled) reports the last scroll direction. Draw a toolbar through a slide shader that hides it while scrolling down and shows it while scrolling up.

6106160780017664.name: CSS caret-shape property
6106160780017664.idea: caret-shape: block is painted into the picture (measured: 215 px against 24 px for a bar). A terminal drawn on a 3D monitor gets a block caret from CSS.

5162372125818880.name: CSS color space display-p3-linear
5162372125818880.idea: display-p3-linear as a CSS colour space gives gradients that interpolate in linear light. Compare a CSS gradient drawn into a float16 canvas with the same gradient computed in the shader.

5176753681203200.name: Refine border-radius shadow edge computation for high border-radius
5176753681203200.idea: Shadows on near-circular elements now follow the curve. Relevant when a shadow is drawn by the canvas from the element's alpha.

5181996801982464.name: Scroll Triggered Animations
5181996801982464.idea: Scroll-triggered animations play, pause or reset an animation when an element enters view. Trigger a shader effect (a burn-in, a shatter in reverse) on each section as it scrolls in, declared in CSS only. Scroll-driven animations inside a drawn element repaint by themselves (measured).

5109852273377280.name: Element-scoped view transitions
5109852273377280.idea: Element-scoped view transitions are covered on the view transitions page: calling it on a child of a drawable canvas crashed Chromium 157.

5459864205393920.name: CSS border-shape
5459864205393920.idea: border-shape is applied to the element picture (measured with a circle). Buttons with arbitrary outlines keep their hit region and arrive in a shader with the outline as alpha.

4841046007742464.name: CSS contrast-color()
4841046007742464.idea: contrast-color() picks black or white against a colour. When a shader tints an element, pass the tint as a registered colour property and let CSS choose the text colour.

5194399398756352.name: CSSPseudoElement interface
5194399398756352.idea: Element.pseudo() returns an object for a pseudo-element, also for a drawn element (measured). Use it to find scroll markers and scroll buttons so they can be placed in the 3D scene.

5179328935624704.name: Pseudo target on events
5179328935624704.idea: Events carry pseudoTarget. A click on a drawn ::scroll-marker can be told apart from a click on its slide.

5080980370096128.name: Support path() and shape() in shape-outside
5080980370096128.idea: shape-outside accepts path() and shape(). Wrap page text around the silhouette of an element that a canvas draws with a non-rectangular outline.

6323071520735232.name: Support rect() and xywh() in shape-outside
6323071520735232.idea: shape-outside accepts rect() and xywh(). Simple exclusion boxes around a canvas-drawn object.

5068127364186112.name: AccentColor and AccentColorText system colors
5068127364186112.idea: AccentColor is a system colour that a canvas can read back as pixels (measured: it returned the default blue outside an installed app). In an installed app it is the user's OS accent. The measurement page records what is readable.

6636392944893952.name: Allow optional rounding parameter for `polygon()`
6636392944893952.idea: polygon() takes a corner-rounding length. Rounded polygons as clip paths for drawn elements.

5183671737909248.name: Animatable zoom
5183671737909248.idea: zoom is animatable. Animating zoom on a drawable element changes its layout size and its picture resolution together, so text stays sharp during the animation. Compare with scaling the draw call.

6234471210811392.name: CSS background-clip: border-area
6234471210811392.idea: background-clip: border-area paints the background only under the border. Gradient borders arrive in the element picture with no extra element.

5121011285622784.name: CSS image(<color>) function
5121011285622784.idea: image(<color>) makes a solid-colour image, usable as a placeholder layer in a drawn element's background stack.

6516055192240128.name: CSSPseudoElement support for ::backdrop, ::scroll-marker and ::view-transitions
6516055192240128.idea: CSSPseudoElement objects for ::scroll-marker and ::view-transition. Script can measure scroll markers to lay them out in a canvas scene.

5070160203481088.name: Relative Alpha Colors (CSS Color 5 alpha() function)
5070160203481088.idea: alpha() changes only the alpha of a colour. Fade an element's colours in CSS in step with a shader's progress property.

5201338641285120.name: window-drag
5201338641285120.idea: window-drag marks regions of an installed app as title bar. A canvas can draw the whole window frame, with drawable children as the drag region and as buttons that are not draggable.

5109685301673984.name: CSS scroll-marker-group modes
5109685301673984.idea: scroll-marker-group gains links and tabs modes with the matching roles. Check the accessibility tree of a carousel drawn in a canvas in both modes.

5114591051907072.name: Expose CSSStyleValue hierarchy to Worker contexts
5114591051907072.idea: CSSStyleValue classes exist in workers. A worker that draws transferred snapshots can receive typed CSS values for its uniforms.

6327898878377984.name: CSS pseudo-class for navigation source element
6327898878377984.idea: A pseudo-class selects the link or button that started a navigation. The canvas reads its box and starts the page transition shader from that element.

5324559251275776.name: CSS random() function
5324559251275776.idea: random() in CSS keeps its value across paints (measured: the same widths on two paints). Give every drawn card its own seed, tilt or delay from CSS: --fx-seed: random(0, 1).

5136856479039488.name: CSS position-visibility:anchor{s}-valid
5136856479039488.idea: position-visibility: anchor-valid hides a positioned element when its anchor is not valid.

5178263526834176.name: CSS text-decoration-inset
5178263526834176.idea: text-decoration-inset trims or extends underlines. Decorations are part of the element picture.

6294595288825856.name: CSS text-overflow: <string> value
6294595288825856.idea: text-overflow takes a custom string. Labels on small 3D surfaces can end in a chosen marker.

5136123851571200.name: Ship anchor-visible and anchor-valid, and deprecate the plural versions
5136123851571200.idea: position-visibility: anchor-visible hides a tooltip when its anchor is clipped. Test whether an anchor that the canvas does not draw this frame counts as not visible.

5174965228929024.name: CSS Custom Highlight Universal Selector ::highlight(*)
5174965228929024.idea: ::highlight(*) styles all custom highlights at once. One rule gives every highlight the colour that a shader keys on.

6207138742534144.name: AccentColor & AccentColorText follows accent-color value
6207138742534144.idea: AccentColor follows the element's accent-color. A drawn control can pass its accent to a shader as a colour.

5152215540039680.name: CSS corner shorthand properties
5152215540039680.idea: Corner shorthands set shape and radius per corner in one declaration.

5071155760332800.name: CSSPseudoElement.selectorText
5071155760332800.idea: CSSPseudoElement.selectorText names the pseudo-element an object stands for.

5508068999430144.name: OffscreenCanvas getContextAttributes
5508068999430144.idea: OffscreenCanvas 2D contexts report their attributes. A worker can check the colour type of the canvas it was handed.

5066778773028864.name: Language support for CanvasTextDrawingStyles
5066778773028864.idea: Canvas text now follows the lang attribute. On pages that mix fillText() labels with drawn DOM, set lang so both pick the same glyph variants (for example Han characters in Japanese and Chinese).

5086141338877952.name: Canvas Floating Point Color Types
5086141338877952.idea: A float16 2D canvas keeps a drawn element's Display P3 colours and values above 1.0 (measured). This is the base of the HDR demo: draw DOM, then raise chosen pixels above standard white.

5122501071994880.name: PredefinedColorSpace srgb-linear and display-p3-linear
5122501071994880.idea: srgb-linear and display-p3-linear canvas colour spaces. Blend and blur element pictures in linear light with no shader conversion.

5172548013916160.name: HTML-in-canvas
5172548013916160.idea: The API this site is about. chromestatus lists it as enabled by default in Chrome 157.

5075532483657728.name: Enhanced Canvas TextMetrics
5075532483657728.idea: TextMetrics gains selection rectangles and glyph cluster queries (Chrome 160). Compare with DOM Range rects, which the particles page uses now. The page could draw text with fillText() per cluster where no DOM is needed and DOM where it is.

5077164932333568.name: Canvas2D tone mapping
5077164932333568.idea: toneMapping: 'extended' on a 2D context shows values above 1.0 on an HDR screen (Chrome 160). With drawElementImage() this is a two-line HDR page: draw the element, then a lighter composite over the parts that should glow.

5207202081800192.name: Full frame rate render blocking attribute
5207202081800192.idea: The full-frame-rate render-blocking token delays first paint until the page can render at full rate.

5199572022853632.name: Controlled Frame API (available only to IWAs)
5199572022853632.idea: Controlled Frame embeds any site in an Isolated Web App. Test whether a controlled frame is drawn as a canvas child, which would put arbitrary sites on the board with a shader.

5078613609938944.name: Dialog Toggle Events
5078613609938944.idea: Dialogs fire toggle events. Start a canvas-drawn backdrop effect when a dialog opens.

5135990159835136.name: DOM State-Preserving Move
5135990159835136.idea: moveBefore() moves an element into a canvas with its state kept. Already used on the capture and slot pages.

5097714453577728.name: Dialog light dismiss
5097714453577728.idea: closedby gives dialogs light dismiss. A dialog is in the top layer, so it is not in the picture of a canvas child (measured for popovers).

6244885579431936.name: Element Reflection
6244885579431936.idea: ARIA relationships can be set as element references. Label a canvas-drawn control from an element outside the component without ids.

5142517058371584.name: Invoker Commands; the command and commandfor attributes
5142517058371584.idea: command and commandfor work on a drawn button (measured: a click opened a popover outside the canvas). Buttons on a 3D panel can open real dialogs and popovers with no script.

5154593776599040.name: Observable API
5154593776599040.idea: Observables: canvas.when('paint') gives the paint events as a stream that can be filtered and mapped. Rewrite the draw loop of one small demo with it and compare.

5592399713402880.name: 'request-close' Invoker Command
5592399713402880.idea: The request-close command asks a dialog to close and lets it refuse.

5165304401100800.name: ToggleEvent source attribute
5165304401100800.idea: ToggleEvent.source is the element that opened a popover. The canvas can start the opening effect from the box of that element.

4530756656562176.name: Interest Invokers (the `interestfor` attribute)
4530756656562176.idea: interestfor on a drawn button opens its hint when the pointer hovers where the button is drawn (measured in Chromium 157, failed in 153). Tooltips for controls on moving or warped surfaces need no script.

6222145025867776.name: Customizable select listbox
6222145025867776.idea: Customisable select covers listbox mode. See the select page for the pickers drawn by a canvas.

5176907844943872.name: Navigation API: add post-commit handler from precommit
5176907844943872.idea: A precommit handler can register the post-commit handler. Simplifies the navigation shader's two phases.

6035800057839616.name: Platform-provided behaviors for custom elements
6035800057839616.idea: Platform-provided behaviours let a custom element act as a submit button. canvas-slot could offer a drawn submit control with native behaviour.

5637601087193088.name: Focusgroup
5637601087193088.idea: focusgroup arrow-key navigation works between buttons drawn in a canvas (measured). A toolbar drawn on a curved 3D panel gets roving focus from one attribute.

6282804208992256.name: Popover=hint behavior changes
6282804208992256.idea: popover=hint stacking was simplified. Relevant when a hint opens from inside another popover that is a drawable canvas.

6297362687066112.name: OpaqueRange
6297362687066112.idea: OpaqueRange gives client rects for text inside an input or textarea, and the rects follow the drawn position in Chromium 157 (measured). The particles effect can now run on the characters a user types into a field.

5136319775899648.name: Opening links in a split tab
5136319775899648.idea: Links can ask to open in a split tab. A second view for the cross-tab demos.

5134941143433216.name: :has-slotted pseudo selector
5134941143433216.idea: :has-slotted matches a slot with content. Style a canvas-slot differently when nothing is slotted.

5175599392620544.name: Fix Selection isCollapsed in Shadow DOM
5175599392620544.idea: Selection.isCollapsed is correct across shadow roots. Relevant to selection in slotted content.

5203351732748288.name: Fix mouse focus for slotted elements in Shadow DOM
5203351732748288.idea: Mouse focus for slotted elements was fixed. Slotted children drawn by a shadow canvas get focus on click.

5971377218912256.name: Selection API getComposedRanges and direction
5971377218912256.idea: getComposedRanges() returns a selection that crosses shadow roots. The text selection effects need it to read a selection that starts in the page and ends in slotted content.

5178682139344896.name: Declarative shadow DOM: shadowrootslotassignment attribute
5178682139344896.idea: shadowrootslotassignment="manual" in declarative shadow DOM. The bare slot demo can assign any element to the canvas slot by script, with no slot attribute on the children.

5188237101891584.name: Reference Target for Cross-root ARIA
5188237101891584.idea: Reference Target forwards label for, commandfor and popovertarget into a shadow root. A label in the page can point at a control inside a canvas component.

4926138582040576.name: Support creating ClipboardItem with Promise<DOMString>
4926138582040576.idea: ClipboardItem accepts strings. "Copy this element" can write a PNG from the canvas and the element's HTML in one item.

5085102657503232.name: Clipboardchange event
5085102657503232.idea: The clipboardchange event fires when the clipboard changes. A drawn clipboard preview can update without polling.

5140028068069376.name: Preserving dropEffect Values from dragover to drop Events
5140028068069376.idea: dropEffect is preserved from dragover to drop. Relevant to drag and drop between drawn elements.

6732314958757888.name: Pointer event suppression on drag start
6732314958757888.idea: Pointer events end when a drag starts. A canvas that tracks the pointer for a lens has to handle pointercancel at drag start.

5203433409871872.name: Selective Clipboard Format Read
5203433409871872.idea: Clipboard formats are read on demand.

6229300214890496.name: EditContext: TextFormat underlineStyle and underlineThickness
6229300214890496.idea: EditContext text formats report underline style and thickness. An editor that draws its own text in the canvas can draw IME composition underlines correctly.

5484282563919872.name: Android IME media insertion
5484282563919872.idea: Android keyboards can insert images and stickers. A drawn contenteditable receives them as real content.

6264645053710336.name: Expose the 'autocorrect' global html attribute
6264645053710336.idea: The autocorrect attribute is exposed. Turn it off for code fields drawn on a 3D terminal.

6715253274181632.name: DataTransfer property for insertFromPaste, insertFromDrop and insertReplacementText input events
6715253274181632.idea: Paste and drop input events carry dataTransfer. An effect can show what was pasted.

5080415048171520.name: Restricting spelling and grammar highlights
5080415048171520.idea: Spelling and grammar markers are restricted to protect the user's dictionary. Measure whether the markers are painted into an element picture that script can read.

6185007701557248.name: Spell check custom dictionary API
6185007701557248.idea: A per-document spell check dictionary. Add the words of a drawn editor's domain so markers do not appear on them.

5179186249465856.name: Permissions Policy: focus-without-user-activation
5179186249465856.idea: A permissions policy stops embedded content from taking focus without a user action. Apply it to embedded cards and board tiles.

5185813744975872.name: Device Posture API
5185813744975872.idea: The device posture API reports folded or continuous. In the folded posture, draw the DOM across the fold with a crease shader and move controls to the lower half.

5170498990243840.name: Viewport Segments Enumeration API
5170498990243840.idea: Viewport segments give the rectangle of each screen half. One canvas spans both; each drawable child is assigned to a segment and the hinge gap is drawn as a bend.

5102801981800448.name: Support font-feature-settings descriptor in @font-face rule
5102801981800448.idea: font-feature-settings in @font-face. Fonts used for 3D labels can enable tabular figures once.

5221379619946496.name: Support font-variation-settings descriptor in @font-face rule
5221379619946496.idea: font-variation-settings in @font-face. Variable font axes animate in CSS and each frame of the animation is a new element picture.

5861138256494592.name: Enable monochrome emoji rendering in forced colors mode.
5861138256494592.idea: Emoji are monochrome in forced colours mode. The accessibility audit covers forced colours in drawn elements.

5169590743203840.name: Open Font Format avar2 text shaping and glyph rendering
5169590743203840.idea: avar2 variable fonts shape and render. Element pictures get the improved interpolation.

6566092561973248.name: CSS font-variant-emoji
6566092561973248.idea: font-variant-emoji picks text or colour emoji. Monochrome emoji tint with a shader; colour emoji do not.

5085419215781888.name: CSS :open pseudo-class
5085419215781888.idea: :open matches dialogs, details and select pickers. Start a drawn effect from the open state in CSS.

5737365999976448.name: Customizable <select> Element
5737365999976448.idea: Customisable select. See the select page.

5109540852989952.name: Gamepad ongamepadconnected and ongamepaddisconnected event handler attributes

5989275208253440.name: Gamepad Event-Driven Input API
5989275208253440.idea: Event-driven gamepad input arrives as events with lower latency than polling. Drive focus between drawn controls, and a ray in the 3D form scene, from a controller.

5075054393163776.name: Gamepad button type attribute
5075054393163776.idea: GamepadButton type names standard buttons. Map "confirm" and "back" without index tables.

5198989277790208.name: Element Capture
5198989277790208.idea: Element Capture restricts a tab capture track to one element. Compare it with canvas.captureStream() of a canvas that draws the element: prompt, frame rate, occlusion and whether shader output is included.

5092615678066688.name: Captured Surface Control
5092615678066688.idea: Captured Surface Control forwards wheel events and zoom to a captured tab. The remote page sends scroll input by hand; compare.

5172464636133376.name: Support for WebHID
5172464636133376.idea: WebHID reaches devices such as a Stream Deck. Draw one drawable element per key, read each key's pixels from the canvas, send them to the device and call click() on the element when the key is pressed.

5077348995825664.name: WebHID on Dedicated Workers
5077348995825664.idea: WebHID in dedicated workers. Encode and send key images off the main thread.

5164958878531584.name: Show true window position on Android
5164958878531584.idea: Android reports the true window position. A tear-off window can be placed relative to the main window.

5111042975465472.name: Out of order streaming
5111042975465472.idea: Out-of-order streaming fills placeholders anywhere in the document as chunks arrive, with no script. Each filled region inside a canvas raises a paint event, so the canvas can draw the arrival of each part.

5090435261792256.name: Scoped Custom Element Registry
5090435261792256.idea: Scoped custom element registries. canvas-slot, dom-portal and dom-lens can be defined in a private registry so two versions can be on one page.

5112013093339136.name: Improvements to styling structure of <details> and <summary> elements
5112013093339136.idea: details and summary accept more layout styling. Animate an accordion's content through a shader while it opens.

5231964663578624.name: Keyboard-focusable scroll containers
5231964663578624.idea: Scroll containers are keyboard focusable. A scroller drawn in a canvas takes arrow-key scrolling.

5113638848561152.name: CSS reading-flow, reading-order properties
5113638848561152.idea: reading-flow sets focus order to follow visual order. When a canvas draws elements in an order that differs from the DOM, test whether reading-flow can state the drawn order.

5612989944299520.name: Focus's focusVisible option
5612989944299520.idea: focus({ focusVisible: true }) forces a focus ring. Synthetic controller input can show the ring that a keyboard would.

5206029088063488.name: Menu elements
5206029088063488.idea: Menu elements are in developer trial. Test a menu opened from a drawn button once it ships.

5121916248260608.name: Multiple import maps
5121916248260608.idea: Multiple import maps. Each demo page can add its own map for a vendored library.

6534495085920256.name: Parse processing instructions in HTML
6534495085920256.idea: Processing instructions are parsed in HTML. They mark the ranges that out-of-order streaming replaces.

5054329641893888.name: Renewed HTML insertion&streaming methods
5054329641893888.idea: streamAppendHTML() and its siblings write markup into an element as a stream. A canvas gets one paint event per chunk with no requestPaint() (measured: 5 chunks, 5 events). The changedElements list says which blocks are new.

5073251081912320.name: popover=hint
5073251081912320.idea: popover=hint. A popover that is a descendant of a drawn element is not in the picture; it is shown in the top layer at its own position and is hit tested there (measured).

6209615938322432.name: Light dismiss improvements for popovers and dialogs
6209615938322432.idea: Light dismiss fixes for popovers and dialogs.

5134353390895104.name: NavigateEvent sourceElement
5134353390895104.idea: NavigateEvent.sourceElement is the element that started a navigation. The transition shader starts from its box.

5134734612496384.name: Navigation API: deferred commit (precommit handlers)
5134734612496384.idea: Precommit handlers defer the URL change. Take an ElementImage of the old page, load the new content, then commit and run a shader between the two pictures.

5101991698628608.name: Partitioning :visited links history
5101991698628608.idea: A canvas gets links drawn as unvisited even when the screen shows the :visited colour (measured in Chromium 153 with a profile that keeps history). History does not leak through getImageData().

5076374013476864.name: User Agent Image Replacement API
5076374013476864.idea: The image replacement origin trial lets the browser swap images for the user. Check whether a replaced image is what a canvas draws.

5143357002874880.name: Dispatching click events to captured pointer
5143357002874880.idea: click goes to the capturing element. Affects libraries that capture the pointer on the canvas and forward clicks.

5151468306956288.name: Interoperable pointerrawupdate events exposed only in secure contexts
5151468306956288.idea: pointerrawupdate delivers pointer moves without frame alignment. Use it for the lens position to cut one frame of latency.

6266812908175360.name: Interoperable Pointer and Mouse boundary events after DOM changes
6266812908175360.idea: Boundary events after DOM changes are consistent. Hover state on a drawn element that is removed mid-hover.

5298387739082752.name: Update text selection on mouseup before dispatching click event
5298387739082752.idea: Selection updates before click on mouseup. Changes event order for selection effects.

6631012282007552.name: Wheel event momentum
6631012282007552.idea: Wheel events mark momentum. A shader that reacts to scroll speed can tell a finger on the trackpad from inertia.

6739764319485952.name: Pointer Lock on Android
6739764319485952.idea: Pointer lock on Android. Mouse-look in a 3D scene with HTML panels on a phone with a mouse or a trackpad.

5668291307634688.name: Temporal in ECMA262
5668291307634688.idea: Temporal. Use it for timestamps in the time scrubber's frame log.

5106098833719296.name: Atomics.pause
5106098833719296.idea: Atomics.pause for spin waits. A worker that waits on a SharedArrayBuffer frame can use it.

5087324181102592.name: Explicit resource management (async)
5087324181102592.idea: Explicit resource management: await using. Wrap ElementImage and VideoFrame so they are closed at the end of a block.

5071680358842368.name: Explicit resource management (sync)
5071680358842368.idea: Explicit resource management: using. Same as above for synchronous scopes.

5164400693215232.name: Float16Array
5164400693215232.idea: Float16Array is the type of a float16 canvas read-back. The HDR probe reads values above 1.0 through it.

6281131254874112.name: Uint8Array to/from base64 and hex
6281131254874112.idea: Uint8Array base64 methods. The transport lab's data URL and JSON routes can encode without a helper.

5191512456560640.name: Import Text (Text Modules)
5191512456560640.idea: Import a file as text: import frag from './ripple.glsl' with { type: 'text' }. Shaders live in their own files with no fetch call and no build step.

6695587390423040.name: WebAssembly JS String Builtins
6695587390423040.idea: JS string builtins for WebAssembly. Cheaper string passing between a Wasm UI toolkit and DOM widgets.

5674874568704000.name: JavaScript Promise Integration
5674874568704000.idea: JavaScript Promise Integration lets synchronous Wasm code wait for a promise. A Wasm toolkit's render loop can wait for the paint event and for DOM measurements.

6024844719947776.name: WebAssembly Custom Descriptors
6024844719947776.idea: Custom descriptors (origin trial) for Wasm GC languages.

5162398704205824.name: Full and unprefixed box-decoration-break support
5162398704205824.idea: box-decoration-break: clone across lines and pages. Affects multi-line highlights in captured pages.

4710507824807936.name: CSS anchor positioning remembered scroll offset
4710507824807936.idea: Anchored elements remember the scroll offset.

6176445286842368.name: CSS 'stretch' sizing keyword
6176445286842368.idea: The stretch sizing keyword fills the available space. Size a drawable child to its canvas.

5201048700583936.name: CSS anchor positioning with transforms
5201048700583936.idea: Anchor positioning resolves against transformed anchors. In Chromium 157 an element outside the canvas, anchored to a canvas child, follows the position where the child is drawn (measured: drawn at 100,50, the anchored element moved by 100,50). In 153 it stays at the layout box.

5157805733183488.name: CSS Gap Decorations
5157805733183488.idea: Gap decorations draw rules in grid and flex gaps and are part of the element picture (measured).

5108373464547328.name: Responsively-sized <iframe>
5108373464547328.idea: An iframe can take its height from its content. Board tiles and slot-view embeds can size themselves to the embedded document.

5197863732772864.name: Margin-trim
5197863732772864.idea: margin-trim removes the outer margins of a container's children. Tight boxes for element textures.

5067363861004288.name: Single-axis scroll containers
5067363861004288.idea: overflow: scroll clip gives a single-axis scroller. A canvas with drawable children can clip in one axis and keep position: sticky working in the other.

4547107962486784.name: flex-wrap:balance
4547107962486784.idea: flex-wrap: balance evens out flex lines.

5174589850648576.name: CSS text-box, text-box-trim, and text-box-edge
5174589850648576.idea: text-box-trim cuts the box to the cap height and the baseline. An element texture then has no empty rows above or below the glyphs, so a label sits exactly on a 3D surface.

5106867491700736.name: CSS letter-spacing and word-spacing: percentage values
5106867491700736.idea: letter-spacing and word-spacing in percent scale with the font size.

5079678972985344.name: `text-justify` CSS property
5079678972985344.idea: text-justify controls how justified text is spaced.

5104141688635392.name: CSS `text-fit` property
5104141688635392.idea: text-fit scales text to fill its box and the scaled text is in the picture (measured). A sign in a 3D scene shows any string at full width with no measuring in script.

5176206485618688.name: Column wrapping for multicol
5176206485618688.idea: column-wrap and column-height wrap columns into rows. A drawn magazine layout whose pages are column rows.

5195769732923392.name: @page margin boxes
5195769732923392.idea: @page margin boxes put headers and page numbers on printed pages. Add them to the print route of element capture.

5159639697850368.name: Unprefixed print-color-adjust
5159639697850368.idea: print-color-adjust without a prefix. Keep backgrounds in a printed capture.

5515971464527872.name: Expose unprintable areas via CSS
5515971464527872.idea: CSS exposes the printer's unprintable margins.

5693137379917824.name: Fluent Scrollbars.
5693137379917824.idea: Fluent scrollbars on Windows and Linux. Scrollbars of a drawn scroller are part of the picture.

6201053052928000.name: Sideways writing modes
6201053052928000.idea: sideways-rl and sideways-lr writing modes. Vertical labels for 3D objects come from layout, with no rotated draw call.

5200068565139456.name: Lazy loading for video and audio elements
5200068565139456.idea: loading="lazy" on video and audio. Measure whether a video that is a canvas child counts as near the viewport and loads.

5082950457884672.name: Pause media playback on not-visible iframes
5082950457884672.idea: A policy pauses media in iframes that are not rendered. Measure whether an iframe that is only drawn through a canvas counts as rendered.

5068277495758848.name: Media element pseudo-classes
5068277495758848.idea: :playing, :paused, :buffering and :muted pseudo-classes (Chrome 158). Custom controls drawn by the canvas restyle from the video's state in CSS, and each change raises a paint event.

5113656292540416.name: Immersive Audio Model and Formats (IAMF) decoding support

5183881532932096.name: Document picture-in-picture: add option to ignore window bounds cache
5183881532932096.idea: Document picture-in-picture can ignore the cached window bounds.

6275022143094784.name: Document picture-in-picture: copy document mode
6275022143094784.idea: The picture-in-picture document copies the opener's quirks mode.

6415506970116096.name: Media session: add reason to enterpictureinpicture action details
6415506970116096.idea: The enterpictureinpicture action gives its reason.

5128855343595520.name: Add support for video frame orientation metadata to WebCodecs
5128855343595520.idea: WebCodecs carries frame rotation and flip. A canvas captured on a rotated phone can be tagged and not redrawn.

5186046555586560.name: Expose rtpTimestamp from WebRTC video frames via VideoFrame.metadata()
5186046555586560.idea: VideoFrame.metadata() exposes the RTP timestamp. Measure end-to-end latency of the remote element stream per frame.

6375884229181440.name: H26x Codec support updates for MediaRecorder
6375884229181440.idea: MediaRecorder encodes HEVC. Add it as a recording format for element video.

6738236535472128.name: CapturedSurfaceResolution
6738236535472128.idea: A capture track reports the pixel ratio of the captured surface.

6267249280286720.name: MediaStreamTrackProcessor frame counters
6267249280286720.idea: MediaStreamTrackProcessor counts dropped frames. Show the count in the transport lab's stream routes.

5146752165478400.name: textStream() for response/request/blob
5146752165478400.idea: textStream() on a response gives decoded text chunks. Pipe a fetch straight into streamAppendHTML().

5068439115923456.name: Disconnect WebSockets on BFCache entry
5068439115923456.idea: WebSockets close when a page enters the back-forward cache. The remote page's signalling socket has to reconnect on pageshow.

5180947573112832.name: WebTransport congestion control
5180947573112832.idea: WebTransport congestion control can ask for low latency. Use it for a pixel stream of one element.

5235261159112704.name: WebTransport send groups and send-stream prioritization
5235261159112704.idea: Send groups and stream priorities. Give input events priority over frames.

5148774971342848.name: WebTransport Datagram readable stream type
5148774971342848.idea: WebTransport datagrams as a readable byte stream. Add a route to the transport lab: encoded frames of an element over datagrams, with late frames dropped.

5183354944225280.name: WebTransport Datagram writable streams and prioritization

5120203192139776.name: WebTransport connection statistics
5120203192139776.idea: WebTransport connection statistics. Show round-trip time beside the stream.

5128261284397056.name: Expose coarsened cross-origin renderTime in elment timing/LCP (regardless of TAO)
5128261284397056.idea: Cross-origin images report a coarse render time.

5162859838046208.name: Add presentationTime/paintTime to performance entries
5162859838046208.idea: Element Timing reports paintTime and presentationTime, and it reports them for text and images that are canvas children (measured). Measure the time from a DOM change to the frame in which the canvas shows it.

5167930847395840.name: LCP: Match specced behavior for emitting candidates
5167930847395840.idea: LCP candidates follow painted images. Check whether LCP names a canvas child or the canvas.

5110962817073152.name: Container Timing
5110962817073152.idea: Container Timing (origin trial) reports when a subtree has painted. Mark a drawable subtree and compare with the paint event.

5144837209194496.name: PerformanceSoftNavigation and InteractionContentfulPaint performance entry
5144837209194496.idea: Soft navigation entries. Relevant to the navigation shader, which is a soft navigation.

5189864286978048.name: CPU Performance API
5189864286978048.idea: The CPU Performance API gives a device tier. Pick the effect quality (mesh size, blur taps, frame rate) from it before the first frame.

5171478175809536.name: Long Animation Frames style and layout duration
5171478175809536.idea: Long Animation Frames report style and layout time. Split the cost of a frame that draws many elements into layout, style and the paint handler.

5186950448283648.name: Enabling Web Applications to understand bimodal performance timings
5186950448283648.idea: Navigation timing reports a confidence value for bimodal loads.

5117170452398080.name: Disable SVG filters on plugins and iFrames
5117170452398080.idea: SVG filters no longer apply to cross-origin iframes (Chrome 150). The same restriction exists for reading pixels. Record what a canvas shader may do to a cross-origin iframe that is a drawable child, and compare with the embed page's route, where the provider draws itself.

5198862739046400.name: Support external SVG resources for 'clip-path', 'fill', 'stroke' and 'marker-*' properties
5198862739046400.idea: clip-path, fill and stroke can reference external SVG files.

6129368025530368.name: Support transform attribute on SVGSVGElement
6129368025530368.idea: transform on the svg root element.

5157546589552640.name: Support path attribute on SVG <textpath> element
5157546589552640.idea: textPath takes a path attribute. Text on a curve as a drawable SVG child.

4861677550043136.name: Support 'path-length' as a CSS property.
4861677550043136.idea: path-length as a CSS property. Animate stroke drawing of SVG in a drawn element from CSS.

4787972240179200.name: SVG Path Data API
4787972240179200.idea: SVG path data as objects (Chrome 160). Read the outline of an SVG path and build the mesh that an element is drawn onto.

5158599457767424.name: Freezing on Energy Saver
5158599457767424.idea: Hidden tabs freeze under Energy Saver. A source tab that streams an element stops when hidden; measure which transports keep it alive.

5386725031149568.name: Faster background freezing on Android
5386725031149568.idea: Android freezes hidden pages after one minute. The remote and cross-tab sources stop when the phone switches tabs; the pages should say so.

5072451480059904.name: Remove clamping of setInterval(...) to >= 1ms
5072451480059904.idea: setInterval(0) is no longer clamped to 1 ms.

6270155647352832.name: Concurrent Smooth scrollIntoViews
6270155647352832.idea: Smooth scrollIntoView calls run concurrently in separate scrollers.

6393888941801472.name: safe-area-max-inset-* variables
6393888941801472.idea: safe-area-max-inset variables. Lay out a full-screen canvas inside the largest possible safe area so it does not resize when the URL bar moves.

5100036528275456.name: ScrollIntoView container option
5100036528275456.idea: scrollIntoView can be limited to the nearest scroller. Scroll a drawn list without moving the page, which the jank guard requires.

5195768556290048.name: Overscroll effect on non-root scrollers
5195768556290048.idea: Nested scrollers show the elastic overscroll effect. Measure whether the stretch of a scroller inside a canvas is in its picture.

5082138340491264.name: Programmatic scroll promises
5082138340491264.idea: Scroll methods return promises. Chain a shader effect to the end of a smooth scroll.

5908461532610560.name: scroll-axis-lock
5908461532610560.idea: scroll-axis-lock lets a gesture scroll both axes. The board's pan could be a native two-axis scroller.

5124378896498688.name: Use scroll-snap-type: pair to snap to a single element
5124378896498688.idea: scroll-snap-type: pair snaps both axes to one element.

5261280285949952.name: Overscroll Areas
5261280285949952.idea: Overscroll areas (origin trial) reveal an element when the user swipes past the end of a scroller. Draw the revealed area through a shader that stretches with the pull.

5086608215900160.name: Scroll snap for single-axis scroll containers

5141940204208128.name: Document-Isolation-Policy
5141940204208128.idea: Document-Isolation-Policy gives one document cross-origin isolation without COOP and COEP. SharedArrayBuffer routes in the transport lab can run on a page that still embeds third-party frames.

5814067399491584.name: Sanitizer API
5814067399491584.idea: The Sanitizer API and setHTML(). Streamed model output and content from another origin can be inserted into a drawable element with scripts removed.

5169798320357376.name: Add javascriptURLs option to SanitizerConfig and Sanitizer
5169798320357376.idea: The sanitizer can allow or drop javascript: URLs.

5915984063889408.name: DeviceOrientation Events permission request API
5915984063889408.idea: DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission() asks for motion data. Tilt the phone to move the light on a foil or hologram shader over a live DOM card.

5118102654418944.name: Web Serial: connected attribute and RFCOMM connection events

5139978918821888.name: Web serial over Bluetooth on Android
5139978918821888.idea: Web Serial over Bluetooth on Android. The test phone can reach a Bluetooth thermal printer or LED sign.

6043992171085824.name: Web Serial API on Android
6043992171085824.idea: Web Serial on Android. Draw an element, dither its pixels to one bit and send them to a receipt printer or an e-paper panel from the phone.

5178378197139456.name: Add MediaStreamTrack support to the Web Speech API
5178378197139456.idea: Speech recognition from a MediaStreamTrack. Transcribe the audio of a video that is drawn in the canvas and draw the captions as DOM.

6090916291674112.name: On-device Web Speech API
6090916291674112.idea: On-device speech recognition. Speak the label of a control that the canvas draws and the page clicks it. Nothing is sent to a server.

5225615177023488.name: Web Speech API contextual biasing
5225615177023488.idea: Contextual biasing takes a phrase list. Build the list from the accessible names of the elements drawn this frame, so recognition favours the labels on screen.

5136859632107520.name: Web Speech API: On-Device Recognition Quality
5136859632107520.idea: A quality setting for on-device recognition.

5811907077472256.name: SpeechRecognitionResult Timestamps (WebSpeech API)
5811907077472256.idea: Recognition results carry timestamps (Chrome 159). Highlight each word of a transcript at the time it was spoken, with custom highlights that a shader animates.

5130361898795008.name: Blob URL Partitioning: Fetching/Navigation
5130361898795008.idea: Blob URLs are partitioned. A blob made in one context cannot be opened in a cross-site frame, which removes one transport.

6284708426022912.name: File System Access
6284708426022912.idea: File System Access on Android. Save a captured PNG or video to a folder the user picks on the phone.

4622243656630272.name: FileSystemObserver interface
4622243656630272.idea: FileSystemObserver reports file changes. Point the board at a folder of HTML files and redraw a tile when its file is saved.

5167864517623808.name: Web haptics JavaScript API
5167864517623808.idea: Semantic haptics (developer trial). Play a tick when focus moves between drawn controls and a boundary pulse when a dragged cloth hits its limit.

4812903832223744.name: ViewTransitions waitUntil() method
4812903832223744.idea: ViewTransition.waitUntil() keeps the pseudo-element tree alive until a promise settles. Keep a transition open while a canvas shader finishes.

5206462350622720.name: View Transitions: shadowRoots option in startViewTransition()
5206462350622720.idea: startViewTransition() takes a list of shadow roots (Chrome 160). Elements inside canvas-slot's shadow root can take part in a transition.

5172068166139904.name: AudioContext Interrupted State
5172068166139904.idea: AudioContext has an interrupted state. The audio page has to resume after a call.

5172818344148992.name: Playback Statistics API for WebAudio
5172818344148992.idea: AudioContext.playbackStats reports latency. Delay the drawn visualiser by the output latency so picture and sound line up.

5078190552907776.name: WebAudio: Configurable render quantum
5078190552907776.idea: The render quantum size is configurable.

5109900936085504.name: OfflineAudioContext incremental rendering
5109900936085504.idea: OfflineAudioContext renders incrementally. Render audio for an exported element video in steps.

5167711051841536.name: WebGPU: Dual source blending
5167711051841536.idea: Dual source blending gives a second colour output for blend factors. With it a shader can apply per-channel coverage, which is what subpixel text needs. Test whether text in an element texture can be drawn with LCD antialiasing on a 3D surface.

5141929256550400.name: WebGPU: Clip Distances
5141929256550400.idea: Clip distances. Cut an element quad with a plane, for a wipe that follows 3D geometry.

5173655901044736.name: WebGPU: 32-bit float textures blending
5173655901044736.idea: float32-blendable. Accumulate element pictures in a float texture for motion trails with no banding.

4609840973086720.name: WebGPU: 1-component vertex formats (and unorm8x4-bgra)
4609840973086720.idea: 1-component vertex formats. Smaller meshes for cloth and jelly.

5126409856221184.name: WebGPU Subgroups
5126409856221184.idea: Subgroups in compute shaders. Faster particle simulation for glyph particles.

5188955424948224.name: WebGPU: GPUAdapterInfo isFallbackAdapter attribute
5188955424948224.idea: isFallbackAdapter reports a software adapter. Pick the 2D path on machines where WebGPU is software, such as the test browser.

5106732252266496.name: WebGPU: GPUTextureView for externalTexture binding
5106732252266496.idea: A texture view can be bound as an external texture. One shader can take a video frame or an element texture through the same binding.

4744775089258496.name: WebGPU 'core-features-and-limits'
4744775089258496.idea: core-features-and-limits tells a core device from a compatibility device.

5080855386783744.name: WebGPU: 3D texture support for BC and ASTC compressed formats

6467722716250112.name: WebGPU: 'primitive_index' feature
6467722716250112.idea: primitive_index in fragment shaders. The shatter transition can colour and fade each shard from its triangle index with no extra vertex data.

5116926821007360.name: WebGPU: Texture formats tier1 and tier2
5116926821007360.idea: Texture format tiers add render and blend support for 16-bit formats. Needed to draw elements into rgba16float targets for HDR.

5110223547269120.name: WebGPU: Texture component swizzle
5110223547269120.idea: Texture component swizzle. View an element texture's alpha as red to use the element's shape as a mask with no second texture.

6680245553987584.name: WebGPU: Uniform buffer standard layout
6680245553987584.idea: Uniform buffers no longer need 16-byte alignment.

6436406437871616.name: WebGPU Compatibility mode
6436406437871616.idea: WebGPU compatibility mode runs on OpenGL ES and Direct3D 11 devices. Add it as a tier in the backend picker, between WebGPU and WebGL, and test drawElementImageToTexture() on it on an older phone.

5102334940151808.name: WebGPU: Texture and Sampler Lets
5102334940151808.idea: Textures and samplers in WGSL let declarations.

5562829589577728.name: WebGPU: Transient attachments
5562829589577728.idea: Transient attachments. Multisample element quads on a phone with no stored MSAA memory.

5199437611794432.name: WebGPU: Immediates
5199437611794432.idea: Immediates. Set per-element uniforms (progress, seed) with setImmediateData() and no uniform buffer per element.

5176273954144256.name: WebNN
5176273954144256.idea: WebNN (origin trial) runs models on the GPU or NPU. Run a small model on the texture of a live element: style transfer as a shader stage, or a saliency model that tells the page which part of its own UI draws the eye.

5116073827893248.name: WebRTC encoded transform -  Modify Metadata functions
5116073827893248.idea: Encoded transforms can modify frame metadata.

6294486420029440.name: Timestamps for RTC Encoded Frames
6294486420029440.idea: Timestamps on encoded frames. Latency measurement for the remote stream.

5113419982307328.name: WebRTC Datachannel: Always negotiate data channels
5113419982307328.idea: Data channels can be negotiated before they are created.

6612726584180736.name: Transferable RTCDataChannel to dedicated workers
6612726584180736.idea: RTCDataChannel transfers to a worker. Handle input events from the remote device off the main thread.

5206373705711616.name: [WebRTC] RTCRtpEncodingParameters.scaleResolutionDownTo
5206373705711616.idea: scaleResolutionDownTo sets a maximum encoded size. Send a phone-sized stream of an element without resizing the canvas.

5175278159265792.name: WebRTC Encoded Transform (V2)
5175278159265792.idea: Encoded Transform. Attach the hit regions of the drawn element to each video frame so the receiver knows where controls are.

5156290162720768.name: RTCDegradationPreference enum value "maintain-framerate-and-resolution"
5156290162720768.idea: maintain-framerate-and-resolution turns off WebRTC's own adaptation. Text in a streamed element stays at full resolution and the page lowers the frame rate itself.

5153479456456704.name: H265 (HEVC) codec support in WebRTC
5153479456456704.idea: HEVC in WebRTC. Compare text legibility per bit with VP9 and AV1 for a streamed form.

6290425179275264.name: WebXr hand input module - Level 1
6290425179275264.idea: Hand joints in WebXR. Press HTML buttons on a floating panel with a fingertip: intersect the index tip with the panel and send pointer events at that point.

5074096916004864.name: WebXR Depth Sensing Performance Improvements
5074096916004864.idea: Depth sensing with lower cost. Hide the parts of an HTML panel that are behind a real object.

5073760055066624.name: XRVisibilityMaskChange
5073760055066624.idea: Visibility mask events. Skip drawing panels outside the visible area.

6634466544058368.name: WebXR Layers
6634466544058368.idea: WebXR Layers. A quad or cylinder layer is composited by the system at display resolution, which keeps text sharper than a texture in the eye buffer. Upload an element into the layer's texture with texElementSubImage2D().

5177993049800704.name: WebXR Plane Detection
5177993049800704.idea: Plane detection. Attach HTML panels to detected walls and tables: a form on the desk, a document on the wall.

5201832664629248.name: Additional Windowing Controls
5201832664629248.idea: Additional windowing controls: maximize, minimize, restore, setResizable and display-state queries. Window buttons become drawable children of the canvas that draws the title bar.

5138641357373440.name: Extended lifetime shared workers
5138641357373440.idea: extendedLifetime keeps a SharedWorker alive after its last page closes. The broker can hold the last picture of a slot for the next tab.

6265472244514816.name: SharedWorker on Android
6265472244514816.idea: SharedWorker on Android (Chrome 148). The cross-tab demo's broker now runs on the test phone; verify it there.

6290352295247872.name: Opaque origin for data: URLs
6290352295247872.idea: Workers from data: URLs get an opaque origin. Affects worker code built from strings.

5114042131808256.name: JPEG XL decoding support (image/jxl) in blink
5114042131808256.idea: JPEG XL decoding. An HDR JPEG XL image inside a drawable element is a test source for values above 1.0.

5133241999425536.name: Extend the console.timeStamp API to support measurements and  and presentation options
5133241999425536.idea: console.timeStamp() takes tracks and colours. Show each canvas's paint handler as its own track in DevTools.

4926233538330624.name: Capability Elements <usermedia> MVP
4926233538330624.idea: The usermedia capability element is drawn as a canvas child (measured). The geolocation element in the same position reports isValid false with the reason "intersection_occluded_or_distorted".

6008183302782976.name: Navigation API: expose destination in navigation.transition

5125006551416832.name: The <geolocation> element
5125006551416832.idea: The geolocation element is drawn as a canvas child, and it reports isValid false with the reason "intersection_occluded_or_distorted" (measured). A canvas cannot restyle or move a permission control and keep it usable.

5153829504024576.name: Capability elements: <camera> and <microphone>
5153829504024576.idea: The camera and microphone elements are drawn as canvas children (measured). Whether a click is accepted there is the open question.

5168096826884096.name: Document Subtitle (Fix PWA app titles)
5168096826884096.idea: Document subtitle sets the installed app's title bar text.

5183927385587712.name: User Navigation Capturing on Desktop
5183927385587712.idea: Links open in the installed app.

5551475195904000.name: Unframed display mode for IWAs
5551475195904000.idea: Unframed display mode gives an Isolated Web App the whole window with no title bar. The canvas draws all of it.

5075144470036480.name: Window Shape API
5075144470036480.idea: The Window Shape API gives an allowlisted Isolated Web App on ChromeOS a non-rectangular window. Set the window shape from the outline of the element that the canvas draws.

5091965583622144.name: Popup Capability Delegation
5091965583622144.idea: A service worker can delegate its popup permission to a page. Open a tear-off window from a notification click.

5098450535055360.name: Camera Effects Status: Background Blur
5098450535055360.idea: Camera background blur status. Compare the system blur with a shader blur over a video element.

5179013869993984.name: Update hidden=until-found and details ancestor revealing algorithm
5179013869993984.idea: hidden=until-found content is revealed by find-in-page. Put a collapsed section inside a drawn element and check that a find reveals it, fires beforematch and raises a paint event, so the canvas can draw the reveal.

6330376953921536.name: Update Device Memory API limits
6330376953921536.idea: Device Memory reports new value steps. One input to the device tier.

6312504658624512.name: Interoperable dispatch timing for transitionrun and media query events
6312504658624512.idea: transitionrun and media query change events fire at interoperable times. Affects code that starts drawing on transitionrun.

5194501932711936.name: Continue running transitions when switching to initial transition value.
5194501932711936.idea: Running transitions continue when transition properties change, so a uniform transition is not cut off by an unrelated style change.

5083947249172480.name: Deprecate Mutation Events
5083947249172480.idea: Mutation events are being removed. The libraries use MutationObserver.

5412736871825408.name: Mobile and desktop parity for select element rendering modes
5412736871825408.idea: Select rendering modes are the same on mobile and desktop.

5084062739988480.name: Support the `hanging` and `each-line` for the `text-indent` property

5203869052960768.name: Use DOMPointInit for getCharNumAtPosition, isPointInFill, isPointInStroke
5203869052960768.idea: isPointInFill() takes a DOMPointInit. Hit test SVG shapes that are drawn in a canvas.
